primary_interest.quote: So I know you wanted to talk about voice AI agents.

use_case.quote: we want to use voice agents for outbound, qualifying leads, that kind of thing.

inference_framing.quote: they plug straight into the voice agent, so there's no separate API wiring on your side.

competitors_inference.quote: We've looked at Baseten a little.

competitors_voice.quote: We've been playing with Vapi for some prototypes. And Bandwidth is on the telephony side, we've talked to them.

decision_criteria.quote: We don't have a huge engineering team, so if it's a long integration, that's a problem.

stated_reason.quote: The conversation has to feel natural. We were told something like 300 milliseconds to first token as a target
